nodes.label: DrCare
nodes.rationale: POS & Inventory Management System; PWA manifest name; application entry point asset builds via Vite

nodes.label: NexoPOS
nodes.author: blair2004
nodes.rationale: Free point-of-sale system built using Laravel, TailwindCSS, Vue; open-source project on GitHub; package.json name is nexopos

nodes.label: Vue
nodes.rationale: Vue 3 via @vitejs/plugin-vue; vue-router, vue-chartjs, vuedraggable dependencies

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS
nodes.rationale: Custom theme configuration with CSS variable color tokens, dark mode via class, custom screen dimension utilities

nodes.label: Vite
nodes.rationale: Build tool v7; configured with laravel-vite-plugin, @tailwindcss/vite, vue plugin, PWA plugin, mkcert

nodes.label: My NexoPOS
nodes.rationale: Documentation hosting platform; marketplace for modules; premium membership support

nodes.label: NexoPOS Cloud
nodes.rationale: Cloud hosting for demo instances

nodes.label: CodeCanyon
nodes.rationale: Premium marketplace for NexoPOS modules; provides $40 My NexoPOS credit, access to marketplace, premium support

nodes.label: Contributor Covenant
nodes.rationale: Code of Conduct v1.4 adapted for the project

nodes.label: vite-plugin-pwa
nodes.rationale: PWA support with auto-update register type, workbox caching strategy for API routes

nodes.label: vite-plugin-mkcert
nodes.rationale: Local HTTPS certificate for dev server on port 3331

nodes.label: Code of Conduct
nodes.rationale: Contributor Covenant v1.4 adapted; enforcement contact contact@nexopos.com

nodes.label: POS Component
nodes.rationale: Place where sales are made and handled; designed for cashier efficiency

nodes.label: Orders Component
nodes.rationale: Lists saved sales; supports receipt opening, refunds, payments

nodes.label: Products Component
nodes.rationale: Product resource management UI for adding product details

nodes.label: Settings Component
nodes.rationale: Configures currency, POS features, orders, and other application sections

nodes.label: Media Component
nodes.rationale: Upload and manage images; field for assigning images to products

nodes.label: Dark Mode
nodes.rationale: Introduced in branch 4.7.x; dark mode via class in tailwind.config.js

nodes.label: Tailwind Theme Configuration
nodes.rationale: Extensive color token system using CSS variables; custom height/width screen fractions; custom spacing, margins, insets; font family Gilroy/Graphik

nodes.label: Application Entry Points
nodes.rationale: Multiple TS entry points: bootstrap, app-init, app, auth, pos, pos-init, setup, update, cashier, lang-loader, dev, popups, widgets, wizard

nodes.label: Workbox API Cache
nodes.rationale: NetworkFirst caching strategy for /api/ routes; 100 entry max; 24-hour TTL
